name: Dynamite

text.trigger: Edward White and John Price are both in play. The player who controls Edward White makes the choice.
text.vignette: Edward has two jars of cloudy liquid on the workbench and a grin that worries everyone in the room. John wants to throw in whatever is under the sink, and Edward is rapidly running out of patience.

options.light-the-fuse: Roll a die. On a 1, Edward White and John Price both die. Otherwise roll another die: that many zombies are removed from the colony and each is replaced by a barricade of rubble.
options.brew-a-batch: A safer use for the chemistry. Next round every player rolls one action die fewer, and morale rises by 1.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #62; The choice belongs to the controller of Edward White (decider). Rubble barricades equal the zombies actually removed.
